notes.title: Updated to version 1.34.0
notes.notes:
- Removed the specification where a brief moment for rotation was inserted just before a jump triggered by Quick Escape.  
- Fixed a bug where, if the dodge button and movement button were pressed simultaneously at the moment of a jump triggered by Quick Escape, the player character would cancel the jump and perform a Dodge Step instead.  
- Changed the appearance of Cellien's HP gauge.  
- Improved, to some extent, the issue where Cellien's HP gauge would be obscured by Cellien's own body.  
- Added a gauge displaying Cellien's impact resistance value, knockdown duration, and similar stats.  
- Added a specification where Cellien's impact resistance value recovery pauses for 1 second when hit by a player character's attack.  
- Fixed a bug where Cellien's knockdown due to accumulated damage would sometimes not occur properly.  
- For "Heliozoa"'s meteor shower attack, reduced the random variation in speed and modified it so the first shot accurately targets the player character.  
- Fixed an issue where the sound effect for "Heliozoa"'s meteor shower attack would sometimes not play.  
- Fixed a bug in the debug room where changing Cellien's ID would sometimes cause the displayed Cellien level in notifications to be incorrect.

notes.title: Updated to version 1.33.4
notes.notes:
- Reduced the spawn rate of "Eomaia scansoria" and "Australopithecus afarensis" in Tokyo Port (hidden area) from 20 to 12.
- Changed the text of the options when using the story switch (giant hat) in Tokyo Port (hidden area).
- Added a warning message about overwriting save data when switching stories in Tokyo Port (hidden area).

notes.title: Updated to version 1.33.3
notes.notes:
- Changed so that when moving from the ground to the air, if in an attack/evade/damage state, the Y-axis velocity is no longer reset.
- Changed so that when using Dodge Step, the Y-axis velocity is set to -9.81 (except for the aerial Dodge Step of Northern White-faced Owl and Eurasian Eagle Owl).
- Added a 0.1-second coyote time to jump, Dodge Step, and Quick Escape.
- Changed so that aerial jump can also cancel attack recovery.
- Changed so that pre-input for the jump button also applies to aerial jump.

notes.title: Updated to version 1.33.2
notes.notes:
- Increased stamina consumption of Serval's Wave Attack when not equipped with Plasma Claw. (12 → 16)  
- Changed so that the effect of Antimatter Emitter is applied to attacks of player-non-controlled Serval (★5) and player-non-controlled Another Serval.  
- Shortened the recovery time of player-non-controlled Serval's Wave Attack. (Now equivalent to player-controlled Serval.)  
- Adjusted stamina consumption of player-non-controlled Serval's Spin Attack and Wave Attack. (Now equivalent to player-controlled Serval.)  
- Changed the enhancement conditions for player-non-controlled Serval's Spin Attack and Wave Attack. (During Wild Release → ★5 and equipped with Plasma Claw.)  
- Slightly increased the motion playback speed of player-non-controlled Another Serval's Wave Attack when not in Wild Release.  
- Added attack hitbox to the right hand of player-non-controlled Another Serval's Wave Attack.  
- Improved the thinking routine of player-non-controlled Another Serval. (Reduced the probability of using Wave Attack. Will not use Wave Attack twice in a row. However, Wave Attack is prioritized if the distance from Cellien is large and Serval is using Wave Attack.)  
- Adjusted stamina consumption of Another Serval's Wave Attack. (During Wild Release: 25 → 20; when not in Wild Release: 15 → 20)  
- Changed Another Serval's Spin Attack during Wild Release so that the attack hitboxes of both the right and left hands can hit Cellien up to 3 times each.  
- Reduced the volume of the sound effect when Antimatter Emitter hits Cellien.  
- Changed the calculation formula for HP recovery speed during Wild Release for Friends. (Only affects when controlling a character other than Serval.)  
- Adjusted the behavior of Kaban's "Paper Plane". (Slightly extended the time from throwing to effect activation. Increased initial speed and adjusted for sharp deceleration.)  
- Slightly altered the appearance of "Anotogaster sieboldii" and "Aedes albopictus" at levels 1–4. (Due to texture reduction.)  
- Fixed a bug where the anger detection on the back of "Scorpiones magnus" would not function properly in high framerate environments.  
- Fixed a bug where, when the config’s "Hell mode" is set to "Serval Only", the HP of Friends other than Serval would not automatically recover during Wild Release.  
- Fixed a bug where, when the config’s "Hell mode" is set to "Serval Only", the HP of Friends other than Serval would not recover with "Ibis Song".  
- Fixed a bug in the debug room where using "ENEMY ID +1" or "ENEMY ID -1" would not correctly reflect the Cellien’s level in the message.  
- Temporarily implemented level 5 Cellien. (Appears only in the debug room. No new attack methods added at this time.)

notes.title: Updated to version 1.33.1
notes.notes:
- Added "Japari Bun 2 Set" and "Japari Bun 4 Set."
- Changed some of the Japari Buns dropped by rescued Friends and those coming out of Japari Containers.
  (2 Japari Buns → Japari Bun 2 Set
   Japari Bun 3 Set + Japari Bun → Japari Bun 4 Set)
- Fixed a bug that could cause unintended combinations of items (a set of 5 Japari Buns and a Markhor Salve) to appear in A-rank Japari Containers.
- Updated and independently improved DynamicBone.
- Completely adjusted Friends' DynamicBone settings.
- Abolished the specification that initializes the Y-axis speed to 0 when Friends transition from attack state to jump state in the air.
- Completely introduced a feature that prevents player-controlled Friends to moving closer to target when the player presses the attack button while pressing the dodge button.
- Fixed a bug that caused the particles effect of Serval's Spin Attack to not change when equipped with a Plasma Claw.
- For Friends other than Serval, the time it takes to be able to cancel an evasion for most attacks when controlled by the player has been reduced.
- Changed so that the passive skills of player-controlled Friends other than Serval are activated.
- Fixed a bug where the playback time of the knockdown motion for player-controlled Friends other than Serval did not match the stiffness time.
- Fixed a bug where experience points were not gained when defeating Cellien when controlled by Kaban, Ibis, Margay, or Campo Flicker.
- Added a feature that cancels the impact force damping and sand star increase amount damping for other Friends only when they are affected by the effects of "Paper Plane," "Ibis's Song," "Voice Mimicry," "Buried Alive," and "Nice Room" by the player-controlled Friend.
- Fixed so that player-controlled Kaban, Ibis, Alpaca, Black-tailed Prairie Dog, Margay, and Campo Flicker can destroy containers.
- Changed so that Friends will not take damage when using bomb-type items by player-controlled Kaban.
A new feature has been added to the player-controlled Kaban, allowing them to throw Japari Buns and summon or strengthen Serval by pressing the special button and attack button.
- About Serval, Jaguar, Moose, Lion, Gray Wolf, and Reticulated Giraffe, a combo attack performed with a Just Dodge Counter will now restart from the third step of the combo.
- Fixed the bone weight of the Hippopotamus' left sideburns.
- Abolished the specification that extended the attack transition distance for Alpaca when fighting boss Cellien.
- Extends the timing at which the lock-on ends for the Alpaca's "Spit!" to the moment the acid is fired.
- Fixed the bone weight of the Humboldt Penguin's headset.
- Adjusted the Humboldt Penguin's attack motion.
- Slightly shortened the interval between various Reticulated Giraffe attacks.
- Reduced the stamina consumed by the Reticulated Giraffe's "Necking" move.
- Changed the command for "Shen Zhen Tie 13500 Catty" when controlling Golden Snub-nosed Monkey.
- Fixed a bug where when a scafollding created by the boss Cellien disappeared, a friend standing on that scaffolding would remain in the air and be unable to move.
- About "B-2," changed so that Cellien will not lock on to the target while it is waiting if the target is within a 6m radius of Cellien and within ±45 degrees in front of it.
- Added an explanation to the screen for selecting the controlled Friend in "Lithograph of Kemono."
- Adjusted the friction of the Japari Bus' tires.
- Changed the wall layer for VR arena to be treated as terrain.
- Adjusted the process where the sun and moon are hidden by friends on floors 27 to 33 of the Skytree.
- Fixed a bug where Wild Release effects were not generated when the Wild Release was automatically enabled due to an event, etc.
- Fixed a bug where only the player's controlled Friend would have their release into the wild released when changing the player's controlled friend in "Lithograph of Kemono" during release into the wild.
- Made some corrections to the translation of the Korean version regarding the "Lithograph of Kemono."
- Changed so that messages are displayed when using various consoles in the debug room.
- Changed so that the options "Callable Friends" and "Other Friends" are displayed when using "SAVE ALL FRIENDS" in the debug room.
- Fixed a bug where using "PROGRESS +1" in the debug room would not cause the main story progress to reach 13.
- Changed so that when using "PROGRESS +1" and "PROGRESS -1" in the debug room, the amulets and various crests held will change depending on the progress.

notes.title: Updated to version 1.33.0
notes.notes:
- Added the "Lithograph of Kemono" function, which allows you to change the player-controlled Friend. (Requirements for use are clearing the main game and a 100% rescue rate.)
- Added a feature that reduces the resistance of the boss Cellien to 0 when its remaining HP is 1, using the Kaban's "Paper Plane," Margay's "Voice Mimicry," and various abnormal conditions.
- Added a feature that allows the boss Cellien's HP to be reduced to 0 by attacks from non-controlled Friends when the boss Cellien is inflicted with an abnormal condition by an attack from a player-controlled Friend (excluding items).
- Added "Serval only" and "Only when attacked" to the "Disable Invincibility" setting.
- Added "Serval only" to the "Hell mode" setting.
- Extended the time that advance input for jump operations is accepted. (0.15 seconds → 0.2 seconds)
- Slightly reduced the time until a counter is possible when a Just Dodge is successful. (0.3 seconds → 0.275 seconds)
- Added a feature that allows the combo stage to be carried over when a combo attack is performed with a Just Dodge Counter.
- Added a feature that extends the maximum distance that the action of approaching the enemy can be moved closer to the enemy when a Just Dodge Counter is performed with a Serval or player-controlled Another Serval combo attack.
- Added a feature that allows the action of approaching the enemy to be moved closer to the enemy when a Just Dodge Counter is performed with a Serval spin attack.
- Added a feature that allows the dodge step to be canceled with a dodge step when a Just Dodge is successful. (In this case, the Just Dodge detection is immediately effective.)
- Fixed a bug that caused the feet to float or sink in some motions for Friends in general.
- Adjusted the playback speed of Friends' walking motions.
- Added an effect in which Friends' footprints are left on the ground in the Snowy Mountains region.
- Fixed the Kaban's "Paper Plane," the Asian Small-Clawed Otter's "Play with Stones," and the Silver Fox's "Homemade Explosives" so that they are thrown forward when there is no target.
- Abolished the feature that caused the hippo's "Big Mouth Challenge" cooldown to fluctuate (varied between 1.5 and 3.5 seconds → fixed at 3.5 seconds)
- Adjusted the motion so that the Jaguar's jump attack is easier to hit the Cellien's weak spot.
- Fixed a bug that caused the Japanese Crested Ibis' shadow to not be displayed.
- Adjusted the playback time of the Sand Cat's "Dig Hole" motion.
- Abolished the feature that caused stamina to temporarily not recover when using the Tsuchinoko's "Riddle Eyes Beam" when maximum stamina was low.
- Fixed a bug that sometimes caused a pitfall to not be created by the Black-tailed Prairie Dog's "Buried Alive" when its stamina was low.
- Adjusted the motion that is played for the 4th stage of the Moose's combo when the target is in a high position.
- Extended the maximum moving distance of the Moose's tackle and changed the easing to easeOut.
- Fixed a bug where the projectile launch effect did not occur for the 4th combo while the Lion's pride was active.
- Fixed a bug where the Northern White-faced Owl and Eurasian Eagle Owl would not be detected by Cellien unless they attacked.
- Fixed the Campo Flicker's "Nice Room" to function properly in the air.
- Fixed a bug where the Campo Flicker's "Nice Room" was not generated in the correct position on the 6th floor of the Savannah region, for example.
- Adjusted the playback time of the motion of the 3rd combo of the Gray Wolf.
- Abolished the increase in the motion speed of the reticulated Giraffe's "necking" when released into the wild.
- Adjusted the playback time of the motion of the 3rd combo of the Golden Snub-nosed Monkey.
- Fixed a bug where the Brown Bear would not move up or down when its "Strongest Bear Stamp" was activated.
- Adjusted the playback time of the Raccoon's spinning punch motion.
- In regards to the behavior of some Celliens that try to maintain a certain distance from the target while attacking, the minimum speed multiplier when approaching the target distance has been changed from 50% to 20%.
(Fixed a bug that caused Celliens to tremble slightly while attacking when holding a purple Minmi Statue.)
- Fixed a bug that caused Red Growl and Birdlien's fireballs to remain even when switching floors.
- Fixed a bug that caused the laser effect of Heliozoa to continue to be displayed after falling outside the arena.
- Fixed a bug that disabled the animation that temporarily hides the weak point stone in Heliozoa's knockdown motion.
- Fixed a bug that played an effect that hides the weak point stone when Heliozoa is knocked down by falling outside the arena with a special knockdown.
- Adjusted the timeline of events during the second form of the final boss.
- Adjusted the progression of events after defeating the boss Cellien on the 33rd floor of the Skytree to proceed slightly slower.
- Fixed a bug that caused the screen to remain blurry if the game ended while viewing the "Cellien Encyclopedia."
- Fixed a bug that caused Serval's movements to become strange in the air immediately after the event at Sunrise Port.
- Changed the wording of some options in the Japanese version. ("サーバルのみオン" -> "サーバルのみ")
- Fixed a bug that caused the brightness of the outline to differ from the Japanese font when displaying Ming-style characters not included in the Japanese font (Simplified Chinese, Hangul).
- Fixed a bug in the Chinese version that caused the outline of some characters in the results of the combat training "BOSS RUSH 2" to not be displayed correctly.

notes.title: Updated to version 1.30.1
notes.notes:
- For the battle assist function, the effective time of automatic avoidance has been extended.
- Fixed a bug that options were not displayed after displaying the result for combat training.
- Fixed some config names and config descriptions in Chinese version.

notes.title: Changed default settings to prevent motion sickness.
notes.notes:
In Version 1.30.0, the default setting of the camera configuration has been changed to something that is less prone to motion sickness.
・ Limit camera turning 1 → 5
・ Camera default view 0% → 15%
For those who are a little worried about motion sickness and have already started the game, change the config as described above, or select "Reset All Configs" from "Change several settings at once" in the config. If you are very concerned about motion sickness, continue to use "Anti-Motion Sickness Settings" from "Change several settings at once".

notes.title: Updated to version 1.30.0
notes.notes:
- Renamed "Accessibility" in Config to "Assist".
- Added "Battle Assist" function limited to NT difficulty to "Assist" in Config.
- Added "Show play time", "Boss mode", "Disable auto-mapping", "Disable invincibility", "Disable Guts", "Disable exp gain", and "Disable item drop" in Config "Expert".
- Added a function that displays the corresponding icon when battle assist, game speed, disable passive skills, hell mode, etc. are on.
- Full-color config icons.
- Adjusted the color of equipment icons and balloon icons.
- Changed the config "camera rotation suppression" to 11 levels from 0 to 10.
- Improved the function of "Limit camera turning" in the configuration. (Increased angle threshold at which camera rotation stops)
- Changed the initial value of "Limit camera turning" in Config. (1→5)
- Changed the initial value of "Camera default view" in Config. (0%→15%)
- Renamed "Difficulty Level Change" in the tutorial to "Difficulty Level Change and Assist Settings" and added an explanation about assist settings.
- Changed the tutorial "Difficulty level change and assist setting" to be displayed at the start of the game.
- Abolished the restriction that the auto-mapping function is disabled when the difficulty level is EN or higher.
- Abolished the distance limit of the function that displays the movement point and the mark indicating friends waiting for rescue when climbing a tree.
- Changed the wording of the tutorial tree climbing page in line with the abolishment of the distance limit for climbing trees.
- When Another Serval performs a combo attack immediately after a jump attack, pile attack, wave attack, or bolt attack, it will start from the second step of the combo. (Specifications similar to Serval)
- Increase the threshold at which Another Serval transitions from normal routine to stamina recovery routine. (Stamina consumption of pile attack → stamina consumption of wave attack during wild release)
- Changed so that "Heliozoa" does not use jump attacks twice in a row.

- Fixed so that the "Search" action is displayed in the barrier destruction event at the entrance of the Sky Tree.

notes.title: Updated to version 1.24.0
notes.notes:

notes.title: Addition of redistributable components, modification of client icons
notes.notes:
-Visual C++ Redist 2019 has been added as a common redistributable component. This redistributable package is automatically installed by Steam. In some environments, there was a problem that Friends did not display properly, and this package was necessary to deal with it.
-Fixed the client icon.
